KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_MAXGADGETPOWER: Your gadgets have more power charges.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DBNOBLEEDTIME: When you're downed, it takes longer before you collapse.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_AITARGETACQUISITION: When you're below 25% health, ARC machines take longer to notice you
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CROUCHSPEED: Your movement speed while crouching is increased.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_ARMORSPEEDPENALTY: Wearing a shield doesn't slow you down as much.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_RECOVERYROLL: You can use the Recovery Roll from higher up.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_EXHAUSTEDSTATE: After an ability drains your stamina, you recover more quickly.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CLIMBSPEED: You can climb and vault more quickly.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_GADGETRECHARGE: Your gadgets' power charges regenerate faster.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_MOVEMENTNOISE: You make less noise when moving.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CRITICALSTAMINAREGEN: When you're critically hurt, your stamina regenerates faster.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_BREACHSPEED: Breaching doors and containers takes less time.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_LOOTREVEALSPEED: When searching a container, loot is revealed faster.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_FALLHEIGHT: You can fall from higher without taking damage.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DODGEROLLDISTANCE: You can Sprint Dodge Roll further.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_LOOTINGNOISE: You make less noise when looting.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CHARGEDMELEE: Unlocks a charged melee attack that deals high damage.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DAMAGESTAMINABOOST: When you're hurt in combat, regain a fixed amount of stamina.  Has a cooldown between uses.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CRITICALHEALTHREGEN: When you're critically hurt, your health regenerates until a certain limit.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_ENCUMBEREDSTAMINAREGEN: Your stamina regeneration is less affected by being over-encumbered.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DRONEMELEEDAMAGE: You deal more melee damage to drones.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_EXPLOSIONEFFECT: Your hearing is less affected by nearby explosions.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_FALLDAMAGE: You take less fall damage when falling from a non-lethal height.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_HEALINGSTAMINAREGEN: While under a healing effect, stamina regeneration is increased.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_WALKINGSTAMINAREGEN: While walking, your stamina regenerates as if you were standing still.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DRONEONEHITMELEEKILL: Wasps and Turrets can now be destroyed with a single melee attack.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_RECOVERYROLLWINDOW: When falling, your timing window to perform a Recovery Roll is increased.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DBNOMOVESPEED: When you're downed, you crawl faster.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DISABLEEXHAUSTEDVAULTS: Vaulting is no longer slowed down while exhausted.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DODGEROLLSPRINTBOOST: After a Sprint Dodge Roll, sprinting does not consume stamina for a short time.  Has a cooldown between uses.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_BREACHVOLUME: You make less noise when breaching.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_AIVISIBILITYWHENCROUCHE: While crouched, you are less noticeable to ARC.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_REDUCEDAIACCURACY: ARC enemies are less accurate when targeting you.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DOUBLELOOTREVEAL: While looting, there's a chance to reveal twice as many items at once.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_DBNODAMAGEREDUCTION: While downed, you take less damage.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CRITICALHPMOVEMENTNOISE: While critically hurt, your movement makes less noise.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_ARMORBREAKFREEDODGEROLL: If your shield breaks, your first Dodge Roll within a few seconds does not cost stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_MINEDISARM: Mines and explosive deployables can be defused when in close proximity
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_VAULTSPRING: Lets you jump at the end of a vault.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_SLIDINGFRICTION: You can slide further and faster.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_REDUCEDWEAPONENCUMBRANC: Your equipped weapon has less impact on your encumbrance.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_MAXCARRYWEIGHT: Increases the maximum weight you can carry.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_MOREFIELDCRAFTRECIPES: Unlocks additional items to field craft.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_BONUSFIELDCRAFTFIND: When looting Raider containers, you have a small chance of finding additional field-crafted items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CROUCHEDSTAMINAREGEN: Stamina regeneration while crouched is increased.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_INROUNDCRAFTING: Unlocks the ability to field-craft items while topside.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_CARRYABLEVAULTING: Lets you vault while holding a carryable.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_REDUCEDFALLRECOVERY: Reduces the time to get back up after a heavy landing.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_WEAPONBASH: Lets you perform a melee attack using your equipped weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_JUGGERNAUT: When your weapon is stowed, allows you to knock back players and ARC while sprinting.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_SCRAMBLEDURATION: While sprinting, increases the time you can scramble up steep slopes.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_FALLGRABHEIGHT: Increases the fall height from which you can grab ledges.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_INCREASEDSPRINTBOOST: Increases the duration of the high speed at the start of a sprint.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_NATURALADRENALINE: Every {0}s, gain the effect of the adrenaline shot for {1}s.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_WALLCLIMB: Sprinting at a wall allows you to run along it for a few steps.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_FLOWSTATE: Chaining together mobility moves while sprinting increases the speed, and reduces the stamina cost.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_NINJAROLL: A faster version of the Dodge Roll, at reduced stamina cost. Covers a shorter distance.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_OVERENCUMBEREDMOVESPEED: Reduces the speed penalty when severely over-encumbered.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_EXPERTSCAVENGING: Increases the amount of ammo and ARC Powercells looted from ARC, and allows you to recycle at full efficiency while in a round.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_SUPERFIELDCRAFTING: Allows you to field craft a much wider range of items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_FIELDREPAIR: Allows you to repair weapons, shields and gadgets up to 30% durability while in a round.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_SPRINTEXTENSION: Stamina never fully drains while sprinting. Any action or damage cancels the skill.  Recovery time scales with duration.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_SPRINTEXTENSION_ALT: While sprinting, you never fully drain your stamina. The effect is canceled when your sprint is interrupted, and more time is needed to recover.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_SUPERFIELDCRAFTING_ALT: Allows you to field craft a wider range of items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_WALLCLIMB_ALT: Sprinting at a wall allows you to run up it for a few steps.
KeysToEntries.ID_ATTRIBUTEDESC_EXPERTSCAVENGING_ALT: Increases the amount of ammo and ARC Powercells looted from ARC.
